title: Dream Team vs Let's Get Messi

events.label: Dream Team opens the match with a pass to the left.
Let's Get Messi presses the left net and takes a corner. Dream Team clears.
Dream Team scores low into the right goal. Let's Get Messi restarts at midfield.
Dream Team scores after a low ball across the face of the right goal. Let's Get Messi restarts at midfield.
Dream Team attacks the right goal. The white goalkeeper sends play back upfield.
Dream Team scores from close range at the right goal with the goalkeeper down. Let's Get Messi restarts at midfield.
The referee signals halftime and the teams leave the pitch.
Let's Get Messi takes the second-half kickoff with a pass back to the right.
Let's Get Messi attacks the left goal. The Dream Team goalkeeper restarts from the goal area.
Scramble in front of Dream Team's left goal. The goalkeeper restarts from the left end.
Let's Get Messi prepares a free kick in front of a Dream Team wall.
Dream Team scores high into the right net. Let's Get Messi restarts at midfield.
White attacks the left post. Dream Team restarts from its own end.
Let's Get Messi heads a cross into the left goal. Dream Team restarts from midfield.
Dream Team scores into the right goal after a close-range scramble shortly before full time.
Approximate full time. Play stops and the teams come together for handshakes.
